A '''resistance group''' opposed the rule of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] in [[3997 BBY]]. During a public execution rally, member [[Farng]] attempted to assassinate Krath leader [[Aleema Keto]]; however, he was killed, and the resistance was quickly crushed.
